body: SKETCH v1 is posted on BUG-2214 (from fable1). It covers: (a) train reuses ship's exact mandate cover (ship_decision) and an extracted shared release function (clear_hold + record_mandate_clearance + PR comment + event + label sync), releasing at land time under the lease with re-arm on failure, plus merge-hold-gate handling for the train PR (wait tolerance + body-edit re-trigger; the workflow itself is untouched); (b) HoldFacts::ClearedByHuman — local clearance record AND forge label state must both agree; everything else (sticky exclusions, operator-only, approval-at-head, two-person) still binds; (c) fetch_ship_refs inside mandate_ship_cover before collect_pr; (d) ten preserved refusals, one test each; (e) two PRs, both human-merged (gate code). Four rulings requested on the comment: Q1 clearance corroboration, Q2 deferring the member-gate hold refusal only while a mandate is active, Q3 train-PR gate re-trigger mechanism, Q4 ship_decision parity for train releases. Waiting on ADVISOR SIGNOFF before writing code.
